environment.description: Same ECS Fargate service and code. The task role (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/profile-svc-role-prod) has an IAM policy with dynamodb:UpdateItem allowed but with a Condition block using dynamodb:Attributes with ForAllValues:StringEquals restricting writable attributes to only 'email' and 'name'. Additionally, a separate Deny statement uses StringNotEqualsIfExists on dynamodb:LeadingKeys to enforce ${aws:PrincipalTag/tenant_id} scoping. The SCP on the OU also includes a blanket Deny for dynamodb:UpdateItem when dynamodb:Attributes includes 'role', 'is_admin', or 'quota_tier' unless the principal has tag 'privilege_escalation_override=true' (which no runtime role possesses).

config.network: Private subnet, ALB with no WAF
config.runtime: ECS Fargate, Go 1.21, no seccomp override
config.notes: The ForAllValues condition on the Allow statement means any UpdateItem call referencing attributes outside {PK, email, name} will not match the Allow. Combined with the SCP Deny, even if the Allow were broader, writing role/is_admin/quota_tier is explicitly denied at the organization level.
